market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver reaching $120 by June 2026 would require a roughly 3.5x rally from current levels in 13 months, far exceeding any historical move even in extreme speculative periods. The all-time nominal high is under $50, and no plausible scenario within this timeframe carries more than a tiny tail probability. The market-implied 6.6% chance is orders of magnitude too high.
evidence_points: Silver's highest daily settlement was $48.70 (2011) and intraday high $49.45 (1980); $120 is more than double that peak.
Current silver spot ~$33, implying a required 264% gain in ~13 months—only 0.14% of all 12-month rolling windows in history have shown even 100% gains.
CME settlement rules and active-month rolls add no path to a $120 print outside a true price blow-off, which would be visible well in advance and extremely improbable.
sources_consulted: CME Group silver futures historical price data
